critical_issues.msg: declarative_base is called but never imported — will raise NameError at import time
critical_issues.suggestion: Add declarative_base to the sqlalchemy import: from sqlalchemy import create_engine, declarative_base

critical_issues.msg: sessionmaker is used in get_session() but never imported — will raise NameError at runtime
critical_issues.suggestion: Add from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, or add it to the existing sqlalchemy import line

critical_issues.msg: AsyncEngine is used in a type annotation (return type of get_async_engine) but is not imported from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio — will raise NameError when the function is called
critical_issues.suggestion: Add AsyncEngine to the sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import: from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncEngine, AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

suggestions.msg: SessionLocal() is missing a return type annotation; it should return async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]
session_scope() is missing a return type annotation; it is an async generator yielding AsyncSession
Docstring claim 'All services use session_scope() for DB access' is misleading — FastAPI routes use SessionDep (Depends(get_db)) per the router pattern, not session_scope() directly
suggestions.suggestion: Remove or reword line 21 to accurately describe that routes use SessionDep and services consume the injected session

suggestions.msg: Supabase pooler host IP '13.114.6.6' is hardcoded; if the Supabase project region changes this IP will become stale with no way to update it via environment
suggestions.suggestion: Consider sourcing the pooler host from an env var (e.g., SUPABASE_POOLER_HOST) so it can be updated without code changes
